setting: environment exact, training seeds 301,302,303,304,305 (5 runs per arm)

definitions.score: rel of train_family.py: per training combination, the mean greedy makespan over the validation instances divided by the mean MWKR makespan over the same instances, averaged over the combinations; lower is better
definitions.late_change: 100 (mean score over 0.8U < u <= U / mean score over 0.6U < u <= 0.8U - 1); negative = still improving
definitions.best_at: first update at which the minimum score was reached, divided by U
definitions.gain_second_half: 100 (minimum score over the run / minimum score over u <= 0.5U - 1); zero or negative
definitions.raw_curve: the score against the update (key curve of each run); per group the median, minimum and maximum over the seeds at each update (raw_curves); for the specialists of both lengths also the mean over the combinations of the per-combination medians
definitions.change_after_1000: arm long: 100 (mean score over 1600 < u <= 2000 / mean score over 800 < u <= 1000 - 1); negative = the validation schedules shortened after update 1000
